summary: Enhance your SQL skills with our Microsoft T-SQL Training Course. Learn from experts and master database management in a hands-on environment.
lede: T-SQL programming helps data analysts, engineers, database administrators and developers retrieve, transform and manage data in SQL Server environments. Learners practice combining tables with JOINs, building CTEs and window-function analyses, and creating stored procedures with transaction and error handling. They also examine execution plans, tune queries and work with JSON data for reporting, data extraction and application workflows.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for data professionals and engineers who interact directly with Microsoft SQL Server environments and need to elevate their database programming capabilities.
modules: Advanced Data Combining and JOIN Operations
Modern T-SQL Workflows and Cloud Integration
prerequisites: Participants must have a basic understanding of relational database concepts, including tables, rows, and columns, alongside fundamental data analysis principles. Prior exposure to writing simple SQL queries (such as basic SELECT statements) is highly recommended. No advanced programming experience is necessary, as the course builds T-SQL syntax progressively from foundational concepts to advanced implementation.
